
```{r data_gen, echo = FALSE, results = "hide", message = FALSE}
# library(randomNames)
# library(tidyverse)

# set.seed(1778384294)
name <- randomNames(which.names = "first")

rolls <- sample(2:12, 20, replace = TRUE)
sum_str = paste(sort(rolls), collapse = "+")

table <- as.data.frame(table(rolls))
table$prod <- paste(table$rolls, table$Freq, sep = "x")

freq_678 <- filter(table, rolls %in% c(6, 7, 8))$Freq
str_freq_678_add <- paste(freq_678, collapse = " + ")
str_freq_678_comma <- paste(freq_678, collapse = ", ")

freq_all <- table$Freq
str_freq_all_add <- paste(freq_all, collapse = " + ")
str_freq_all_comma <- paste(freq_all, collapse = ", ")

## Solution
res <- sum(freq_678) / sum(freq_all) * 100

## Plot
palette <- sample(palette.colors(palette = "Dark2"), 1)

plt <-
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = rolls)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, colour = "black", fill = palette) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(rolls), by = 1)) +
  xlab("Roll Total") +
  ylab("Frequency") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16)
  )

fn <- "item_5"
path <- file.path("items/rexams", paste0(fn, "_assets"))

# Ensure matching tmp dir exists
dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Save and load plot in temp dir
ggsave(
  file.path(path, paste0(fn, ".svg")),
  plot = plt,
  units = "cm",
  width = 12,
  height = 8
)

include_supplement(paste0(fn, ".svg"), dir = path)
```

Question
========
`r name` rolled two six-sided die and plotted their values on the histogram below. What percentage of the rolls were either a 6, 7, or 8?

![](item_5.svg)


Solution
========
Each bar shows the number of times a certain value was rolled. Therefore the total percentage of rolls for 6, 7, and 8 is . . .

$$
\begin{align}
\text{Percent} &=
\frac{`r str_freq_678_add`}{`r str_freq_all_add`} \times 100 \\[0.5em]
&= \frac{`r sum(freq_678)`}{`r sum(freq_all)`} \times 100 \\[0.5em]
&= `r fmt(res, 2)`
\end{align}
$$

<br>

**R Code:**

```
freq_678 <- c(`r str_freq_678_comma`)
freq_tot <- c(`r str_freq_all_comma`)

sum(freq_678) / sum(freq_tot) * 100
```
